build_TransformerDecoder: build a TransformerDecoder with args, dictionary, and token embeddings for inverse folding
run_forward_pass: run the TransformerDecoder forward pass with prev_output_tokens and optional encoder output
extract_features: extract features from input tokens through the decoder layers without output projection
create_future_mask: create a buffered causal attention mask for self-attention in the decoder
build_output_projection: build the output projection layer mapping decoder embeddings to vocabulary size
